summary: Tests whether a 3D point lies inside a triangle projected onto a 2D plane. A selector (first argument) picks one of six projection/winding modes; modes 0-3 run inline cross-product edge tests and modes 4-5 delegate the same three edge tests to the F_2DCrossProduct helper. Returns 1 when every edge test passes (point inside), 0 otherwise; an unhandled selector returns 1.

local_names.a2: array of three triangle vertex pointers (float3)

operations.description: Dispatch on selector a1 through jump table jpt_54EB4D (0x0054EE74); cases 0-5 select the projection plane and winding direction, default falls through to inside result
Load triangle vertex 0 pointer (a2[0]) from obj base offset 0x0
Load triangle vertex 1 pointer (a2[1]) from obj base offset 0x4
Load triangle vertex 2 pointer (a2[2]) from obj base offset 0x8

Run cross-product edge tests between triangle edges and the test point coordinates (point X/Y/Z at this offsets 0x0/0x4/0x8); reject as outside when an edge test has the wrong sign for the selected winding
Edge tests compare the cross-product sign against the zero threshold constant flt_59E440 (0x0059E440)
Cases 4 and 5 delegate the three edge tests to F_2DCrossProduct(vertex, 0, 1) (0x0054EE90), returning 0 immediately when an edge test fails
Return 1 (inside) when all three edge tests pass for the selected projection, 0 (outside) otherwise; unhandled selector values return 1
